pages.title: Social Purpose | NAIS Rotterdam
blocks: Through one-of-a-kind opportunities and collaborations, your child will make a real difference in our school, locally, and across the globe. We’ll support them to become a principled global citizen, too, building character, kindness, and empathy through our Core Values Programme (CVP) and holistic approach to learning.

Our Student Council are role models in school and our community, mentoring our younger children, giving their peers a voice, and supporting local and international charities, including WWF, Pink Ribbon, and Nederland Voedselbank. Our student kindness club collects and delivers books, food, and clothes to local families, too. And through our Creativity, Activity and Service (CAS) programme, IBDP students identify an authentic community need and work together to find practical solutions.

We encourage our students to act with integrity, to be considerate, and to learn the skills they need to thrive as individuals, family members, and part of society. Our Core Values Programme (CVP) and Values, Inquiry, and Perspectives learning approach – both of which are embedded into every student’s day – create a strong sense of community, encourage personal responsibility, and develop a strong moral compass.

Through our exclusive collaboration with UNICEF, your child will learn about the challenges facing our planet – and take action to address them. Activities surrounding World Children’s Day teach our students about their rights, how to protect them, and how to advocate for those who may not have a voice. And through our Model United Nations programme, your child will research, debate, and propose solutions to pressing global issues.

Supported by our caring and committed teachers, your child will learn in a way that works for them, enjoying personalised experiences that nurture their talents and ensure they get outstanding results.

pages.title: Netherlands International Private Schools | NAIS Rotterdam
blocks: Nord Anglia International School Rotterdam (NAISR) is a warm, supportive, and closeknit community where every student gets the care and attention they need to thrive. Your child will love learning here, guided by world-class teachers who will tailor every aspect of their personal and academic education.
WHY CHOOSE OUR INTERNATIONAL PRIVATE SCHOOL?

Every day, we challenge and support our students to be the best they can be. Our caring and committed teachers make sure each child learns in a way that works for them, giving them the care and attention they need to succeed.

As well as helping our students to flourish academically, our private school in Rotterdam, Netherlands invest heavily in their personal and social development, too. Your child will not only get outstanding academic results, but they’ll also become a principled, independent global citizen, ready to shape the world.

In 1959, our private school opened in Rotterdam with just 15 English-speaking students and one teacher. An influx of American military and expat families in Rotterdam and across The Netherlands saw us grow, and today our inclusive international community is home to more than 230 students from over 35 countries.

From day one, our goal has been to support the unique needs of each child in a small but aspirational community. We also strive for excellence in everything we do, and in 1982 we became the first school in Europe to be accredited by the European Council of International Schools. We moved to our current campus in 1995, which was opened by Crown Prince Willem Alexander.

Our class of 1999 was the first to follow the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme (IBDP). Ever since, our students have raised the bar. In 2021, they achieved an average IBDP points score of 36.9, 10% above the global average and the best results in our history.

We joined the global Nord Anglia Education family in 2018. This has brought so many benefits, from access to world-leading education technology and award-winning teacher training programmes, to exclusive collaborations with MIT and UNICEF.
